patterns.note: Full-bleed video sections and full-screen content blocks create a cinematic, immersive experience, often with text overlays.
Large, bold sans-serif headings contrast with smaller, lighter-weight body text and uppercase labels, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy.
A minimalist black and white base is dramatically accented by vibrant, dynamic video content and a prominent, textured gradient section.
The hero features a dynamic video that changes on scroll, and the navigation logo transforms from text to an icon as the user scrolls down the page.
Full-screen content sections are revealed with a distinct transition as the user scrolls, replacing the previous content rather than simply scrolling underneath.
Content is organized into distinct, full-screen sections, each with a unique visual treatment (video, grid of cards, textured gradient).

technique_notes: Uses a dynamic, full-bleed video hero that can transition between different clips, often with a fixed text overlay. Implements a sticky header where the logo visually transforms from a text string to an icon upon scrolling past the initial hero section, likely using CSS keyframes. Employs scroll-triggered full-screen section reveals, where new content blocks with distinct backgrounds (like a textured gradient) slide or fade into view, replacing the previous content, likely orchestrated with GSAP ScrollTrigger.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter-weight body text and uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous whitespace around hero text and full-screen content blocks, with a balanced grid for feature cards.

standout: The site's standout feature is its dynamic, full-bleed video hero that transitions between different clips on scroll, combined with a sophisticated logo transformation in the sticky navigation. This creates an immersive and highly polished visual experience that feels more like a cinematic presentation than a typical website.
